title: What practice inevitably presupposes is not negotiable

statements.text: Notions that are inevitably presupposed in practice, such as the efficacy of conscious decisions, should be the nonnegotiable elements of a belief system. A theory that denies them contradicts itself in practice, and a fallible opinion such as materialist physicalism should not veto them.

sources.quote: those notions that we inevitably presuppose in practice should be regarded as the nonnegotiable elements in our belief systems
